excused.reason: Lightspeed's interactive consent screen, documented in prose on the V1 authorization overview (https://api-portal.lsk.lightspeed.app/quick-start/authentication/v1-authentication/v1-authorization-overview, fetched 2026-10-29) and absent from source.json, whose securitySchemes names the V2 OpenID Connect authorizationUrl. This unit serves a stand-in at the documented path that approves automatically; its route summary says so.

The V1 token endpoint, documented in prose only (same page, fetched 2026-10-29): code exchange from query parameters, refresh from a form body, HTTP Basic client authentication, a five-member JSON response. source.json's securitySchemes tokenUrl is the V2 OpenID Connect one, so no operation describes this route.

One keyword, one pointer, the two routes.
